source: NBC 2016 Part 8 (Lighting & Ventilation) & ECBC 2017 Bioclimatic Architectural Guidelines
description: Bioclimatic reasoning templates that match real design attributes against site microclimatic conditions.

templates.template: High thermal mass ({wall_material_display}) dampens peak heat waves, moderating indoor temperatures during {hottest_month_max}°C summers.
Thick thermal mass ({wall_material_display}) retains indoor heat and stabilizes nocturnal temperatures when outdoor lows hit {coldest_month_min}°C.
Low thermal mass ({wall_material_display}) sheds heat rapidly after sunset, avoiding night-time radiative heat traps in humid {hot_season_humidity}% RH weather.
Cross-ventilation orientation with open aperture layout maximizes convective skin cooling under sustained humid ({hot_season_humidity}% RH) conditions.
Nocturnal purge ventilation flushes daytime heat stored in the envelope using cooler night ambient air.
Thermal stack effect draws cooler ambient air through low inlets while discharging buoyant warm air through high roof relief vents.
Pitched {roof_type_display} profile ensures rapid rainwater runoff drainage against {annual_rain} mm annual monsoon precipitation.
Steeply pitched gable roof cleanly sheds heavy seasonal snow accumulation, eliminating structural ponding and freeze hazards.
South-angled monopitch solar roof maximizes photovoltaic capture and passive winter insolation ({solar_mean} MJ/m² daily solar radiation).
Central open courtyard acts as a nocturnal microclimatic cooling sink, inducing evaporative thermal circulation throughout adjacent living spaces.
Elevated stilt foundation protects the primary living core from surface water runoff and monsoon ground saturation.
Elevated floor platform captures higher-velocity boundary layer wind currents above ground level for improved natural ventilation.
High-performance envelope insulation minimizes conductive thermal bridging when ambient temperatures fall to {coldest_month_min}°C.
Deep external overhangs and louvered shading block peak solar radiation while preserving natural daylighting and ventilation pathways.
Bio-based vernacular envelope utilizing locally sourced {wall_material_display} significantly cuts embodied carbon and environmental footprint.
Economical level {estimated_cost_level} vernacular construction strategy delivers high cost efficiency using accessible regional trade techniques.
